title: KnowledgeUse
description: One piece of company knowledge a candidate cites, and whether the candidate actually follows what the knowledge says. Retrieval, applicability, citation and conformance are four different facts and this record is the last two: knowledge_attribution.v1.json keeps retrieved, applicable and used apart, and a candidate that cites an id is only 'used'. conformance says whether the candidate's action agrees with the guidance clause. It is never called influence: nothing here shows the knowledge changed the candidate (that needs a run without it). The E16.3 and E8.11 evals read it.

guidance_clause.description: The words of the knowledge's guidance the candidate is held against, quoted from the knowledge version in force.

artifact_span.description: Where in the candidate the clause shows up (or should have): the field and the quoted words. quote is null when the candidate says nothing about it.

conformance.description: followed: the candidate does what the clause says. overridden_with_reason: it departs from the clause and says why. contradicted: it departs and gives no reason. ignored: it cites the knowledge and never acts on it. unknown: it cannot be established.

allOf.description: An override states its reason; no other conformance carries one.
